description: Language-neutral conformance vectors for the 13 Moons Pattern Calendar. Generated from the JS PatternCalendar in ssnfts24/scroll-of-fire (the fixture-verified reference) by scripts/generate-pattern-calendar-vectors.mjs, after asserting Aaron's canonical fixtures. Inputs are an unambiguous UTC instant plus timeZone/boundaryMode/sunsetTime; expected values are the implementation's full scalar summary. The vendored copy in ssnfts24/living-phone must stay byte-identical.
